title: AMLR UBO Beneficial Ownership Mapper
description: Map beneficial ownership under AMLR (Reg (EU) 2024/1624) and AMLD6 (Directive (EU) 2024/1640). 25% threshold. Layered structures, trusts, foundations, and complex chains. Applies 10 Jul 2027.
